body:
Implement ADLC v1.13.0 Wave 1A Part 2 Foundational Security & Containment across @adlc/prosecute, @adlc/autopilot, @adlc/lesson-foundry, @adlc/gate-manifest, and @adlc/cli:

1. @adlc/prosecute (T-P05): Enforce ticket-scoped iterative carriedFrom ancestor & same-digest needs-attention truncation chain walking in attestation-store/cross-model; NFKC vendor-family normalizeProvider provenance + fail-closed non-empty authorProvider anchoring; and .adlc/ / .omo/evidence/ / custom --dir non-symlink evidence path containment in run.mjs and adlc-prosecute.mjs.
2. @adlc/autopilot (T-P02): Disable reflog updates (core.logallrefupdates=false) and guard .git/info/exclude against symlinks in gate-repo.mjs; align review.mjs isolation.
3. @adlc/lesson-foundry & @adlc/gate-manifest (T-P08): Reject symlinked, dangling-symlink, non-file, staged-deleted, staged-symlink, and truncated byte-prefix ledgers in ledger-guard.mjs; update enable.mjs segment-chain CI notices.
4. @adlc/cli (T-P09): Scrub ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY and enforce non-blocking async spawn with bounded concurrency (DEFAULT_MAX_MCP_CONCURRENCY = 4), queue cap (DEFAULT_MAX_MCP_INFLIGHT = 32), immediate overload reply, and AbortSignal/SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP child termination in mcp-server.mjs.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Prosecute carry-forward truncation, vendor-family provenance, single-source base, and evidence path containment tests pass. Verify: npm --workspace=@adlc/prosecute test && node --test plugins/adlc-cursor/test/mcp-wrapper.test.mjs
2. Autopilot gate-repo symlink guard, lesson-foundry staged-symlink/deletion ledger-guard, and gate-manifest enable notices pass. Verify: npm --workspace=@adlc/autopilot --workspace=@adlc/lesson-foundry --workspace=@adlc/gate-manifest test
3. CLI MCP server secret-scrubbing and bounded async concurrency/queue tests pass. Verify: npm --workspace=@adlc/cli test
title: Wave 1A Part 2: Prosecute provenance & truncation hardening, autopilot/ledger symlink guards, and bounded async MCP
